name: Grid Control (for phone)
description: Keep the lights on: a classroom game where every phone runs one power plant - coal, gas, wind or battery - on a shared electricity grid shown on the big screen. Drag your output up or down and keep the frequency at 50 Hz together, through a morning ramp, a windy day, batteries, a storm and a plant trip. Teaches power balance, inertia, ramp rates, the merit order and storage. Runs over Supabase Realtime; nothing is stored.
